pipeline: base training on data/versions/exp006, then fine-tuned on data/versions/exp001_exp003_exp006

stage_2_finetune.note: mAP50-95 measured on the EXACT SAME validation set as exp001 (0.935) and exp003 (0.951) - verified byte-identical file lists - so this number is a genuinely valid apples-to-apples comparison, not just a similar-sounding metric.

stage_1_base.note: Measured on exp006's own (smaller, 408-image) validation set - not comparable to exp001/exp003/stage_2 numbers above.

note: Trained on a laptop (Linux), outside this project's usual Windows desktop workflow - no wandb tracking was recorded for either stage (brought in after the fact, see experiments/exp006_yolo26s_finetuned/config.yaml and base_stage/config.yaml for the original Ultralytics args.yaml of each). src/exp006_yolo26s_finetuned.py reproduces this exact two-stage recipe, wired into this project's normal conventions, for any future retrain.
